title: Six Figs and a Pig
lines: Tim has six figs in a tin.
Tim hid the tin in a big bin.
A pig got in the bin!
The pig did not fit. The pig is big.
The pig tips the bin and sits.
Tim is sad. His figs sit in mud.
But the pig digs and digs.
The pig digs up a big fig.
Tim and the pig sit in the sun.

questions.ask: Where did Tim hide the tin?
questions.listenFor: In a big bin. It is said in the story. If they guess, have them find the word bin and read that line again.

questions.ask: How did the figs end up in the mud?
questions.listenFor: The pig got in the bin and tipped it over. Two steps, so it is fine to look back for both parts.

questions.ask: Do you think Tim and the pig are friends now? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: There is no right answer. You want a reason from the story - the pig dug a fig back up, or they sit in the sun together at the end.
